title: Phase Diagrams
description: Two metals mixed melt lower than either alone, and at one ratio all at once. Unlocks the Phase Diagram Kiln.

puzzle.goal: Two metals are mixed, a of the first and b of the second by weight. Write the share x of the second.
puzzle.name: Lever rule
puzzle.ask: Find x for a = @{a} g of lead and b = @{b} g of tin.
puzzle.method: A share is the part over the whole. Tin-lead is eutectic at 62% tin, 456 K.
